controls.title: Buyer, supplier, admin, billing, verification and private-document flows are reproducible
controls.notes: Post-merge Quality #61 passed authenticated HTTP smoke, PostgreSQL 17 migration/seed, immutable container build and dependency audit on main 410c98ef.

controls.title: Controlled Beta access, kill switch, demo-only data policy and noindex are enforced server-side
controls.notes: PR #45 merged as main 410c98ef after green Quality/Security; post-merge Quality #61, Security #63 and the signed-expiry/kill-switch policy tests passed.

controls.title: The Beta database is migrated, seeded with demo-only data and persists across restart
controls.notes: Beta Launch #1 attempts 1 and 2 stopped at the GitHub Environment secret-presence check before any Railway command executed. Migration, demo seed and persistence readback remain blocked until the beta job receives RAILWAY_TOKEN and BETA_ACCESS_TOKEN.

controls.title: An immutable application image is deployed at an external HTTPS provider URL
controls.notes: GitHub Environment beta and the provider resources exist, but the environment-scoped RAILWAY_TOKEN and BETA_ACCESS_TOKEN expressions both resolved to empty strings on two live attempts from main 7ca30e41. The fail-closed workflow exited before provider readback or mutation.

controls.title: A clean external client verifies TLS, health, catalog, authentication and protected routes
controls.notes: The external smoke implementation is merged, but Beta Launch #1 correctly stopped before provider discovery because both GitHub Environment secret contexts were empty; no external request was attempted.

controls.title: A debug APK built from the launch commit is available as a CI or release artifact
controls.notes: Main 410c98ef reproducibly produced debug artifact 9227617669 (SHA-256 f86c154c711f4e79e6330993722ce3c9edfca03e208bd3a0aaef00888596bbb2) for the local emulator. Beta Launch #1 stopped before provider URL discovery, so no external-origin APK or checksum was produced; do not create a production signing key.

controls.title: Main SHA, image digest, migration, SBOM, tag and prerelease notes identify one launch candidate
controls.notes: The fail-closed launch workflow is merged on main 7ca30e41. Image digest, deployed migration evidence, external-origin APK, tag and prerelease remain intentionally absent because Beta Launch #1 received no environment secrets and stopped before Railway access.

controls.title: Rollback, monitoring access and the Beta kill-switch procedure are verified
controls.notes: The application kill switch passed policy and local runtime smoke. Beta Launch #1 stopped before provider readback, so Railway rollback, persistence verification and final-candidate restore were not attempted.
